$comment: usage-max enforced profile: Opus 5.5 hub (ceiling), Sonnet/Haiku subagents. Effort medium everywhere (Anthropic's Opus 5.5 default; raise per session with /effort high|xhigh|max for hard problems). promptCacheTtl 5m: replaying this machine's sessions showed the 1h cache never paid for its 2x write rate (re-check with /usage-max:diagnose). Prompt suggestions off (background requests). ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL pins the 'opus' alias (plan mode, /model opus) to 5.5. Merge into ~/.claude/settings.json (back it up first). Idle-waste off: no goal check-ins, cross-session messages held, auto-continue after a usage-limit reset. Background/telemetry requests off (telemetry, survey, away-summary recap, terminal-title model call); BASH_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH 15000 caps tool output re-sent every turn (default 30000). CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL 5m: subagent runs are short bursts, so the 1h cache write (2x) rarely pays back (needs a recent Claude Code; unknown variables are ignored).
